🧭 How EndaViral Works · Lesson 4 of 5

Getting Help Fast, and Getting Paid Back

4 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

A ticket that starts with your order ID gets traced in seconds. A ticket that says 'my followers didn't come' starts a back-and-forth that can eat a day.

Support is faster when you hand it what it needs on the first message. This lesson covers where to look before you ask, the ticket format that skips the back-and-forth, and the rewards most customers forget they're earning, including one that pays you.

Check these three things before you ask

  1. My Orders. Statuses update by themselves. Processing on a drip-feed service is normal, not stuck.
  2. Your link. Open it in a browser. Is the post still up, public, and under the same @username?
  3. The chat widget. It answers common questions about status, pricing and how services work straight away.

The ticket that gets solved first time

📋 Copy-paste ticket
Order ID: [from My Orders]
Service: [exact service name]
Link used: [paste it]
Quantity ordered: [ ]  Delivered so far: [ ]
What I expected: [e.g. start within 1 hour]
What happened: [e.g. still Pending after 6 hours]
M-Pesa code (if a payment issue): [ ]
Screenshot attached: [Y/N]
💡 What most people miss

One order, one ticket. If three orders have problems, list all three IDs in a single ticket. Opening several tickets, or re-ordering 'just in case', splits the trail support has to follow.

Real support never asks for these

No growth order needs your social media password, a login code, or your M-Pesa PIN. Only a public link. Anyone in your DMs claiming to be 'EndaViral support' who asks for those is a scammer. Instagram has said that third-party apps asking for your login are a sign of trouble, and it tells affected users to change their password.

Rewards you're already earning

RewardHow it worksEasy to miss because...
Free ordersEvery 5 orders = 1 free orderSmall test orders count too
Loyalty pointsEarned from orders, can unlock premium Academy lessonsThey sit quietly in your account until you use them
Refer & EarnAbout 7.5% of what people you refer spend, credited when their orders completeIt keeps paying every time they re-order
WithdrawalsReferral earnings go to M-Pesa from KES 100KES 100 is only about KES 1,330 of referral spend

The Refer & Earn rate is about 15% of each order's profit share, which works out to roughly 7.5% of what your referral spends. Your exact figures always show in the Refer & Earn section, and cancelled orders don't earn.

✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

Two of your orders look stuck. What gets them fixed fastest?

Order IDs let support trace your exact orders. Re-ordering stacks deliveries, and repeat tickets split the trail. Real support never asks for passwords in DMs.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Check My Orders, your link and the chat widget before you open a ticket.
  2. Lead every ticket with the order ID, and put several orders in one ticket.
  3. Nobody legitimate needs your password, login code or PIN.
  4. Refer & Earn pays about 7.5% of referral spend, withdrawable to M-Pesa from KES 100.
